name: eval-dagger-years-greedy
note: The same network as eval-dagger-years, but always taking its highest-scoring choice instead of picking by chance in proportion to the scores. Picking by chance, it made 431 put-down moves per village that the bot had not asked for and threw away what it had gathered.
command: ML/evaluate.py --model ML/experiments/20261008-1927-dagger-years/model.pt --name eval-dagger-years-greedy --villages 16 --days 28 --greedy --note "The same network as eval-dagger-years, but always taking its highest-scoring choice instead of picking by chance in proportion to the scores. Picking by chance, it made 431 put-down moves per village that the bot had not asked for and threw away what it had gathered."
